description: Packaged defaults for the Automation Skill Foundry. Copy this file, edit the DEFAULTS block, and pass it with --config PATH. Values here override the built-in fallbacks in tools_common.py.

notes.max_items: Upper bound on skills in one bundle; extra skills are trimmed with the safety-stage rule and listed in limits.trimmed_skills.
notes.ask_skill_limit: Default number of candidates the router takes from search when no recipe matches.
notes.deny_risk_levels: Add "critical" (or "high") to refuse routing/planning at that risk level outright.
notes.workspace_dir: Default project directory used by tools_scaffold.py and schedule launchers.
notes.out_dir: Reserved for callers that batch several runs; the tools always honour --out.
